company.name: Axion
company.shortDescription: Axion is an AI-powered customer quality intelligence platform that identifies and resolves product quality issues.
company.description: Axion provides an AI-driven platform that helps product and quality teams detect, investigate, and resolve customer-facing issues earlier by unifying data from field, service, and design sources. Its software continually analyzes structured and unstructured data to surface emerging problems, correlate root causes, and support workflow collaboration from early signal through corrective action. The platform also offers insights into patterns and trends in product performance, connects cross-functional teams on a shared workspace, and helps organizations monitor the effectiveness of fixes over time. Axion’s technology emphasizes proactive identification of issues to improve product outcomes and support ongoing quality improvement across complex product lifecycles.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven software platform that automates engineering and quality analytics to detect and resolve manufacturing quality issues early.
